content.title: Lock and unlock an allocation segment by clicking it
content.intent: Prove clicking a segment maintains a focused allocation state and clicking the same segment again clears that lock.
content.technique_notes: Applied equivalence partitioning across allocation segments because the click-lock behavior should be uniform for every slice. covering_array on asset_class degraded to effective_t=1 from requested strength 2 because only one input existed, so this scenario sweeps Equities, Fixed Income, Alternatives, Cash, and Commodities as equivalent representatives. Budget ceiling=8 existed; budget_cut kept this scenario as a core interaction path.
